CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.has_business_role(check_business_id uuid, allowed_roles text[])
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1 from public.business_members bm
    where bm.business_id = check_business_id
    and bm.user_id = auth.uid()
    and bm.role = any(allowed_roles)
  );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_business_member(check_business_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1 from public.business_members bm
    where bm.business_id = check_business_id
    and bm.user_id = auth.uid()
  );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.pin_save_state(p_token text, p_data jsonb)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'extensions'
AS $function$
declare a public.pin_accounts%rowtype;
begin
 select pa.* into a
 from public.pin_sessions ps
 join public.pin_accounts pa on pa.id=ps.account_id
 where ps.token_hash=encode(digest(p_token,'sha256'),'hex')
 and ps.expires_at>now()
 and pa.active=true;

 if a.id is null then raise exception 'Session expired'; end if;
 if pg_column_size(p_data)>5000000 then
   raise exception 'Data size limit exceeded';
 end if;

 insert into public.app_state
 (business_id,data,updated_at,updated_by)
 values(a.business_id,p_data,now(),null)
 on conflict(business_id)
 do update set data=excluded.data,updated_at=now(),updated_by=null;

 return true;
end $function$
